retrieved_at_note: Rounded to the hour by the original capture and pinned into the published artifacts' created_at and sources[].retrieved_at, so it cannot be re-pointed without changing their content_sha256. The exact instant of the original download is not recoverable from this repository; see verification.archive_redownloaded_at for an independent re-download whose bytes hash to the content_sha256 below.
license_or_terms: Public EIA data; see EIA terms of use.
capture_method: HTTPS GET of the EIA archive URL above; sha256 computed from the response body. The workbook members are read in place from the zip with pandas.read_excel at the published header offset; no cell value is edited or synthesized.
source_scope: Form EIA-860 reporting plants and generator records. The EIA early-release notice says these files are not fully edited, may exclude records pending validation, and are inappropriate for aggregation.
coordinate_scope: Schedule 2 reports plant latitude and longitude. Schedule 3.1 generator and 3.4 storage records attach to plant IDs but do not provide unit coordinates, terminals, network edges, or facility polygons.

verification.sha256_computed_from_response_body: An independent HTTPS GET of source_ref returned 23,285,571 bytes hashing to content_sha256 above.
verification.verified_counts_rederived_from_the_archi: Schedule 2 plant rows, Schedule 3.1 generator rows, Schedule 3.4 storage rows and out-of-range plant coordinates were recounted per state from that archive and match verified_counts exactly.
verification.parser_contract_under_test: pipelines/tests/test_eia860_physical.py runs the parser over pipelines/tests/fixtures/eia860/eia8602025ER-slice.zip, a byte-reproducible slice cut from this archive by scripts/cut_eia860_test_slice.py; see that fixture's PROVENANCE.json.
verification.artifacts_rederived: docs/data/acceptance_receipts/eia860-2025er-physical-inventory.json records the artifact and intake hashes re-derived from this archive and the contract commit they were validated against.
verification.not_verified: EIA republishes the early release in place and nothing here re-checks the live URL on a schedule; a future download may differ from content_sha256.
